title: Strategic Intake Runway Reconciler for Escalated Top-Accounts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We lack a single, auditable mechanism to reconcile competing scope and timeline asks from top customers during roadmap planning windows. Sales/CS escalate features with contractual language and short runways; engineering needs deterministic commitments to capacity and dependency windows. This ticket establishes a 'Runway Reconciler' process, tooling, and decision guardrails to intake escalations, map them to capacity bands (fastpass / standard / deferred), and produce a prioritized, trackable plan that ties to OKRs and release buckets.

Why now: Several enterprise customers flagged unclear commitment timelines in Q1 renewal cycles, and we had two separate incidents where escalation promises conflicted with capacity for Dedicated pools. Fixing this reduces churn risk and prevents scope creep during cycle cutoffs.

Scope: Design intake form + gating rules; decision matrix mapping to commitment lanes; a lightweight prioritization UI in Console (triage view) for PM + ENG + Sales; Slack escalation channel + automated digest; acceptance criteria and rollout playbook. Initial MVP will be limited to top-accounts flagged by ARR and contract-risk tagging (CS-provided list).

Out of scope: Full automated SLA enforcement against contractual penalties (follow-up phase).
goals: Create a repeatable process to intake escalations and return a commitment decision within 10 business days
Reduce ambiguous promises by 80% for flagged top-account asks during the quarter
Wire stakeholder notifications into Console/Triage and link decisions to OKR initiative IDs
success_metrics: % of escalations with documented decision within 10 days >= 90%
Reduction in customer support escalations related to roadmap timing by >= 60% over next quarter
Number of engineering hours saved from double-booked scope <= 20h/month
work_streams: Intake form + metadata contract (CS and Sales) - PM
Decision matrix and SLA thresholds - Product + Legal
Triage view prototype in Console - Eng + DevExp
Integration: add triage digest to Slack and link to ticket - Infra
Rollout: internal playbook + training for CS/Sales - PM Ops
acceptance_criteria: Intake form captured with customer, ARR, contract window, requested timeline, and consequence notes
Decision matrix implemented and documented in Confluence with examples for fastpass vs standard vs deferred
Triage view in Console shows at-a-glance lane, owner, estimated scope points, and linked ticket
Automated Slack digest posts every Monday with new escalations and current decisions
Rollout checklist and one live walkthrough session recorded for CS and Sales
notes: Trade-offs discussed: stricter gating speeds decisions but risks frustrating Sales; for MVP we prioritize documented decisions over always-pleasing customers.
Canary approach: enable for top-50 ARR customers first; expand to top-200 after 2 cycles if SLOs are met.
We will not attempt to auto-enforce contractual SLA refunds in MVP; Legal prefers manual review before any penalty triggers.
